1. (Currently amended) A method for generating a superframe preamble for a superframe, the superframe preamble comprising a plurality of symbols, in an orthogonal frequency division multiplexing (OFDM) network, comprising: for a first one of the symbols, allocating a first set of subcarriers of a carrier to a first broadcast channel, the first set of subcarriers distributed over substantially the entire carrier __with a distribution pattern that varies based on channel conditions__; and for the first one of the symbols, allocating a second set of subcarriers of the carrier to a second broadcast channel.

2. (Currently amended) The method as set forth in Claim 1, the first set of subcarriers distributed uniformly over substantially the entire carrier __in a manner that is dynamically adjusted based on system requirements__.

3. (Currently amended) The method as set forth in Claim 1, the first set of subcarriers distributed non-uniformly over substantially the entire carrier, according to a pre-determined pattern __that is selected based on channel state information or network configuration parameters__.

4. (Currently amended) The method as set forth in Claim 1, the second set of subcarriers distributed over substantially the entire carrier __in a complementary pattern to the first set of subcarriers__.

19. (Currently amended) A superframe generator in a base station in an OFDM network, comprising a preamble generator operable to generate a superframe preamble comprising a plurality of symbols for a superframe by (i) for a first one of the symbols, allocating a first set of subcarriers of a carrier to a first broadcast channel, the first set of subcarriers distributed over substantially the entire carrier __with a distribution pattern that varies based on channel conditions__, and (ii) for the first one of the symbols, allocating a second set of subcarriers of the carrier to a second broadcast channel.

20. (Currently amended) The superframe generator as set forth in Claim 19, the first set of subcarriers distributed uniformly over substantially the entire carrier __in a manner that is dynamically adjusted based on system requirements__.

21. (Currently amended) The superframe generator as set forth in Claim 19, the first set of subcarriers distributed non-uniformly over substantially the entire carrier, according to a pre-determined pattern __that is selected based on channel state information or network configuration parameters__.
